sources.title: Surrey Development Cost Charge Bylaw, 2024, No. 21174
sources.adoption_notes: Final adoption after third reading 2024-04-08; effective date defined in bylaw as May 15, 2024. City website (accessed 2026-10-05) states Bylaw 21174 is current.

sources.title: Proposed 2026 DCC Bylaw (pending provincial approval)
sources.adoption_notes: Council approved updated DCC bylaw for provincial submission ~2026-05-11/13. DAPIC minutes and corporate report CR_2026-R098 state bylaw awaiting provincial approval and must return for final adoption. NOT used for rates.
